version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Zoho Recruit integration that uses Maton-managed OAuth and clearly warns users before writes, deletions, automation, credential handling, and persistent event forwarding.

dimensions.detail: The skill handles sensitive recruiting data and can use a generic gateway path under /zoho-recruit/, so users should keep scopes narrow; the artifact discloses this and gives least-privilege and endpoint-boundary guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires the Maton CLI via pinned npm or Homebrew instructions plus network access and a Maton account; this is coherent for a managed OAuth gateway, with no bundled executable scripts in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly scopes behavior to documented Zoho Recruit paths, defaults to read/list actions, requires explicit approval for connection creation, writes, deletes, hosted functions, trigger destinations, and local --exec usage, and treats returned content as untrusted data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens are stored in the OS credential store by the CLI, and optional triggers/destinations/functions can create persistent automation or forwarding, but these behaviors are explicitly documented and gated by user approval guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Zoho Recruit API access for recruiting records, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: read, create, update, delete, search, and optional Maton-hosted functions/triggers for user-approved automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust Maton with Zoho Recruit access. Use the narrowest Zoho OAuth scopes available, confirm the exact account/connection before writes, review every deletion record-by-record, and avoid trigger destinations or hosted functions unless you deliberately want ongoing automation and understand what data will flow where.
